description: Fetch the full public record for an id returned by search (for example "ngo:<id>", "event:<slug>", "volunteer:<id>", "fund:<id>", "store:<slug>", "product:<id>", "library:<slug>", "page:/about").

id.description: The id of a search result, such as "ngo:<id>".

name: fetch

metadata.description: Structured fields of the record, including recordType and contentLanguage.

text.description: Full public text of the record, in its original language unless metadata.translated is true.

url.description: Public page of the record on hangel.org.

title: Fetch a record
